response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile engineer (15+ years, CS degree) with genuine strengths in full-stack product work, developer tooling, testing frameworks, and some high-throughput low-latency service work at Sociomantic/dunnhumby. However, the resume shows no evidence of the core requirements for this Principal/IC6 role: no experimentation or A/B testing platform work, no telemetry/metrics infrastructure ownership, no statistical or experimental-analysis background, and no demonstrated growth-engineering outcomes. Scope also reads as senior/staff IC within single teams at small-to-mid companies rather than Principal-level, cross-org, multi-workstream leadership at enterprise scale in globally distributed multi-region systems. Language fit is partial (TypeScript/JavaScript strong; C/C++/Java/C# present but dated or secondary), and Python is absent. Strong engineer, but a poor match for this specific specialization.
strengths: 15+ years broad engineering experience with CS degree; strong craftsmanship, TDD/CI/CD culture
Real low-latency, high-volume service experience (microservices handling millions of req/sec)
Builds reusable tooling/frameworks and teaches widely (test runners, workshops, OSS platform, AI-agent/MCP tooling)
concerns: No experimentation, feature-flighting, or rollout-risk/bias-detection experience
No demonstrated telemetry, metrics infrastructure, or statistical/data-analysis depth
Scope and influence appear team-level, not Principal/IC6 cross-org at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Deep, broad engineering tenure and distributed high-throughput systems work
